name: Guangzhou Yuexiu Capital Holdings Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Yuexiu Capital Holdings Group Co., Ltd. operates a financial holding platform in China. The company offers financial leasing business products, such as livelihood project, inclusive leasing, high-end equipment, operating lease, and clean energy business; asset management business, including acquisition of public non-performing assets; transfer of public non-performing assets; debt restructuring; bankruptcy reorganization; substantial restructuring; standardized debt investments; and bulk acquisition of individual non-performing assets.
